claimed_coverage: Tests that all-null categorical columns and all-null/partially-null nullable integer extension columns are properly handled during pandas-to-Arrow conversion, ensuring the resulting TileDB attributes have isnullable=True.
fix_patch_grounding: The fix modifies df_to_arrow() to cast all-null object columns to pd.StringDtype() and all-null categorical columns to pd.CategoricalDtype() before Arrow conversion, which the test verifies by checking isnullable on empty_categorical_all, empty_categorical_partial, empty_extension_all, and empty_extension_partial columns.
issue_context_used: The issue describes the need for proper handling of all-null categorical and nullable integer extension columns during TileDB conversion, which directly informed the test assertions checking isnullable properties.
notes: The test patch from /tasks/test.patch is copied to /artifacts/evaluation/test.patch and applied at runtime. The test fails on buggy code (exit code 1) and passes with the fix (exit code 0).
